_comment: Maps NCBI taxon ID -> the gene-ID database prefix PANTHER uses for that species' leaves in its family/tree data (not Ensembl-style IDs). Empirically derived by sampling PANTHER treeinfo responses across multiple PTHR families and cross-referencing against modules/local or the post_proc image's prefix_2_species.json (which covers everything else via standard Ensembl prefixes, e.g. ENSDAR, ENSRNO). Species not listed here should fall back to that Ensembl prefix table.
